attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a mouth matching the source expression. Preserve the real source hair, brows, and conditional facial hair. The subject wears a grey/green peaked cap with broad gold bands and a central gold motif, featuring a dark visor. Short grey temple and real brow hair are visible, with a smooth understated upper lip and chin, and a serious closed downturned mouth. Fine eye-rim and upper-lip shading in the small primary image are indistinct; do not invent prominent new glasses or a moustache. The garment consists of grey/green open military lapels with real red collar-tab areas containing only tiny source-visible pale or gold marks, a white or pale shirt collar, and a dark green necktie beside the note. Keep the actual red collar area, not a plain business suit or closed bare tunic. The rounded chin must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib is allowed. Preserve the actual source open garment and observed inner collar or neckwear state, ensuring coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories are permitted. Fine primary details that are indistinct must remain understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Near-frontal/mildly angled military bust, GREY/GREEN peaked cap with broad GOLD bands/central gold motif and dark visor. Short GREY temple and real brow hair, smooth understated upper lip/chin, serious CLOSED downturned mouth. Fine eye-rim/upper-lip shading in small primary is indistinct: do not invent prominent new glasses or moustache. GREY/GREEN OPEN military lapels, real RED collar-tab areas with only tiny source-visible pale/gold marks, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK GREEN necktie beside note. Keep actual red collar area, not a plain business suit or closed bare tunic.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Do not copy the human long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy; fit the source collar to the compact rounded head. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small source, full returned master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Cap, grey hair and eyebrow hair, serious clean closed mouth, open green uniform, source red collar tabs, pale shirt and dark green tie are retained. However the yellow lower face tapers into a pronounced pointed V immediately above the tie; it does not meet the compact rounded-chin and broad short-neck collar requirement. Queue a separate source-bound builtin art repair for this exact raw master, retaining the actual open garment and red collar tabs. Fine eye-rim/upper-lip detail is genuinely indistinct in the small primary and is not the rejection reason. Backing/frame/note are visibly opaque and intact.
